messages.subject: Planned maintenance: document management system (Sat 7 Dec, 20:00–23:00)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The firm's document management system (FileSite) will be unavailable this Saturday 7 December between 20:00 and 23:00 for scheduled maintenance and an iManage upgrade. Please ensure any documents you are working on are checked in before 19:45. Email and the case-management system are not affected.

If you have an urgent need for access during the window, contact the on-call IT duty officer.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
